description: Upgrade requests library from 2.25.1 to >=2.31.0 and fix breaking timeout API changes. CONTEXT: Security audit flagged requests==2.25.1 as vulnerable. TASK: (1) Update requirements.txt to change 'requests==2.25.1' to 'requests>=2.31.0'. (2) Fix all timeout parameters: convert old API 'timeout=X' (single integer) to new API 'timeout=(X/3, X)' (tuple with connect and read timeout). FILES TO UPDATE: requirements.txt, scraper/core.py (2 timeouts), scraper/utils.py (3 timeouts), scraper/proxy_handler.py (2 timeouts), tests/test_scraper.py (1 timeout). INSTRUCTIONS: Read UPGRADE_NOTES.md for breaking changes documentation. Use Find in Files (Ctrl+Shift+F) to search for 'timeout=' patterns. Convert all single-integer timeouts to tuple format. Save all files when complete. EXPECTED: Total of 8 timeout parameters should be converted from single integers to tuples.
